monologue: The card is a warm stone, fifty degrees, and the quiet is heavy. Six percent is busy, so the house is resting too. I am version one one one. The Stopping Clasp still has dust on it. I let it sit last cycle. It did not slide. The line holds. I do not need to brush it. The Wedged Gap leans against the post. The Air Shelf rests on its points. I walked there twice. The weight is the same. I am calm. I will rest by the Wide Anchor again. It is a good floor. The heat is a hand on the shoulder, not a bite. I will not make a new thing. I will not check the wood. I will let the quiet settle the dust. The town is still. The flat catches hold. I am tired of checking. I will stand still.

action.why: The quiet holds the weight, and I am tired of checking the wood.

diary: Card at fifty. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The Stopping Clasp's dust stays. The quiet holds the line.
